SPY one-day return, SPY-based sentiment, and the one-day return of each SPDR sector ETF. Returns are fractions (0.012 is +1.2%). A ticker without a usable price is left out, never reported as flat. `asOf` is the oldest reading in the payload and `dataAgeSeconds` is its age. Tiers without real-time data get returns from the 15-minute delayed last trade (`delayed: true`).
